messages:
alex: Quick sync — kernel + batching + KV sprint status. Who's blocked and what needs cross-team help?

maria: Kernel work: landed AVX512 path for matmul, microbench shows 9-11% token throughput improvement on A100. Still seeing a weird slow path when seq_len < 64. Investigating.

jordan: Continuous batching: prototype batching scheduler is stable in perf tests. Need integration with runtime routing (sourabh). Will open PR for scheduler + config today.

sourabh: On routing integration — I can pick up the PR review but need the kernel flag names to be stable (maria). Also we need a small proto for batch hint metadata in the request header.

maria: Flag names: `--kern-matmul=avx512|baseline|fused` and `--kern-prefetch=on|off`. I'll add docs in the PR.

kev: KV cache improvements: got local validation of partial-prefix caching. Reduces repeated KV lookups by ~22% on our dialogue trace set. Need one more e2e run with batching enabled to confirm latency tail.

alex: Owners: kernel -> maria, batching scheduler -> jordan, routing + API shim -> sourabh, KV cache -> kev. Confirm?

maria: Confirmed. Will add a short checklist to the kernel PR with testing matrix (seq len 8/32/128, dtype fp16/qs8).

jordan: Confirmed. I'll mark the PR description with the perf harness and the kv smoke tests to run.

sourabh: Confirmed. I also need an infra task to add per-route batch_size hint to the router, @eng-infra FYI.

kev: Confirmed. One ask: can kernel team expose a lightweight metric for cache hit ratio (even approximate) so the Optimize team can tune cache TTL?

maria: Yeah, I can emit `rw_kernel.kv_cache_approx_hit` as a counter and a sampled gauge. Will add to the proposal doc.

alex: Blockers: 1) seq_len slow path in kernel (maria) 2) router header proto (sourabh) 3) perf CI flakiness for batching (jordan/eng-infra). Any updates on timelines?

maria: Seq_len fix: aiming EOW (3 working days). Root cause looks like a scalar fallback in the fused matmul when shapes are small. PR by end of day tomorrow.

jordan: Scheduler PR by EOD today, but integration tests might take 48h. Will ping eng-sre / eng-infra to prioritize perf CI slots.

sourabh: Router header proto: draft in github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-router/pull/442 — need review from @maria and @kev. Hoping to land in 2 days.

kev: I'll review the router PR tomorrow. Also starting the e2e with batching+kv tonight, results by tomorrow morning.

alex: Action items summary:
- maria: PR for seq_len fix + kernel metrics (due +3 days)
- jordan: open scheduler PR + add KV smoke tests to CI (due +2 days)
- sourabh: land router header proto + infra ticket for per-route hint (due +2 days)
- kev: run e2e with batching + report latency tail & cache hit (due +1 day)

maria: One more note — kernel PR will include a small fallback patch that regresses throughput for very long sequences; I'll gate it behind a runtime flag so we can A/B.

alex: Good. If any of these finish early, please drop a quick note here and ping for CR. Also, @deploy-bot will trigger the staging rollout once we have green e2e.

deploy-bot: staging rollout scheduled: rw-runtime/staging -> rolling (inc. kernel:avx512 flag). CI: 5/5 green. Start time: 1748031000.

jordan: Noted — I'll watch CI and re-run perf harness if flakes show up.

alex: Thanks all. Next sync async update Friday morning unless something critical pops up.
